_schema: Declared dependency manifest. This file is the single source of truth: scripts/check-deps.sh reads it, remote-install.sh reads it, and DEPENDENCIES.md documents it. Add a dependency HERE rather than to a script's own list, so the installer, the post-update report and the docs cannot drift apart. The schema of one entry:
_entry: { "id": stable identifier, "check": how to detect presence, "pkg": package name(s) that provide it, "why": what breaks without it, "nudge": (optional, default false) true only if the installer should mention it when absent }
_checks: { "bin": one executable on PATH } | { "bins": ALL of these executables } | { "anyBin": at least one of these executables } | { "service": a systemd unit that must be active }
_core: Required for the shell to work. A missing core dependency is reported loudly.
_optional: Adds a feature that degrades gracefully when absent. Never blocks anything.

core.why: the shell runtime itself — nothing starts without it
IPC for workspaces, monitors, dispatch and reload
desktop notifications for the pill and for these dependency reports
JSON parsing in the helper scripts, and for reading this manifest
opening files and links, including the dependency report page
wallpaper download, thumbnails, palette generation and video-wallpaper stills
the window/region picker for screen recording

optional.why: the screen-recording backend — recording is disabled without it
Material base16 palettes (always-dark terminal theme, dynamic wallpaper palette)
monitor brightness via DDC (external display faders)
the native folder picker for the record output directory
the power-profile picker on the battery hover — the row shows "Not installed" without it, and it isn't needed on desktops
the default lock backend — without it the lock falls back to the built-in Quickshell one, and the LOCK settings surface hides the option
the screen capture behind the lock's capture backdrop — without it that backdrop falls back to the wallpaper
live terminal palette reload via `kitty @ set-colors` (needs `allow_remote_control yes`, and `include ~/.cache/ukishima/kitty-colors` for persistence)
live terminal palette reload over D-Bus
idle / DPMS lock integration alongside the built-in keep-awake
